Jr. Pharmacovigilance Associate Vacancy (updated)
Wednesday, 30 April 2025
3009 Hits
Name of the Post:
Jr. Pharmacovigilance Associate
Essential Qualification:
Master degree in Pharmacy, Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy Practice, and Clinical Research preferably with diploma in clinical research from the recognised institute.
OR
Pharm. D/ MBBS/BDS preferably with diploma in clinical research from a recognised university/Institute.
Desirable Qualification
: One-year experience in drug safety/Pharmacovigilance
Age:
Not exceeding 28 years
Salary –
32,000/- per month
Job Description:
Collection of ADR Reports.
Processing of Individual Case Safety Reports (ICSRs) and managing them in VigiFlow.
Quality review, Clinical Review & Statistical review of ICSRs in Drug Safety database.
Any other work assigned by Competent Authority from time to time.
Last date of Application:
15/05/2025 up to 5.00 pm
Application should be submitted online via email at
pharmacology@office.mgims
.
ac.in
